overview: The West Medford Community Center hosted its monthly 'Fresh Fridays' program, featuring a leadership dialogue on the organization's 90-year history and a live jazz performance.

items.title: Opening and Program Introduction
items.summary: Terry Carter opened the session by announcing a program change due to a guest cancellation and acknowledging the support of the Medford Arts Council.

items.title: Poetry Reading: The Center of It All
items.summary: Carter performed an original poem reflecting on the center’s 1935 founding, its growth from an army barracks, and its role as a multi-generational neighborhood resource.

items.title: Dialogue with Executive Leadership
items.summary: Executive Director Lisa Crossman and Board President Melinda Walsh-Reagan discussed their personal connections to Medford, the history of local banking equity, and the primary challenge of securing the building's future.

items.title: Community Announcements
items.summary: The chair highlighted upcoming senior lunch programs, a Juneteenth celebration on June 19, and a community fish mural project scheduled for May 13.

items.title: Musical Performance by Reese Pike and the Silly Billies
items.summary: Reese Pike introduced her jazz trio and performed a set of original compositions and standards including 'Autumn Leaves' and 'Ugly Beauty.'
